summary: The new monument-top spine makes q09 read much closer to c_27313/14 than w9's flat 0.245 m slab: a slim ridge between two dark grooves now runs inboard over the monument. But it was placed at the monument centre (z -0.0875), which is not where the photos put it. In c_27313/14 the spine meets the aisle-end cap at its middle, between the 17E and 18D plaques, and fillets into it. Our cap spans z -0.58..0.035, so the spine lands about 20 % along it (r3, r5, and a cabin close-up in the scratchpad). It runs 5.5 cm over the cap with its rail 8 mm proud, and it lies across the even-seat plaque, hiding the '1' of '18D'. That is a new, clearly visible artefact in the exact framing of the paired official photo. The 'metal top rail' uses jPanelEdge #5d6166, the same tone as the shell, so it renders darker than the housings (108-115 vs 117-124 L). In the photo the spine top is about 1.2x lighter than the housing tops. The other w9 items are fixed: E comforter box quilt now reads (r10), soft navy slipper pouch, 2.3 cm pillow checks visible in the cabin, hidden bed overlaps trimmed, and LOD screen height matched. The O comforter in r9 is still a crumpled satin sheet, nearly identical to w9s r9. Ash grain is still about 0.6x the photos. Pair layout, nesting, monitors, tables and caps are unchanged and strong.

issues.detail: The spine runs over the aisle-end cap and lies across the even seat's plaque, covering the '1' of '18D'
issues.problem: Line 438/439: the spine gRBox(1.13, 0.05, 0.028) and rail gRBox(1.134, 0.008, 0.032) are centred at x -0.02, so they reach x 0.545/0.547. The cap is gRBox(0.10, 0.02, ...) at x 0.54 (x 0.49-0.59, top 1.14). The spine therefore crosses the cap's inner 5.5 cm, and the rail (top 1.148) sits 8 mm proud of the cap top. The E plaque (09_seats.js line ~269: [0.545, wall+0.0205, -0.06], 0.055 x 0.065, top about 1.1445) spans x 0.5175-0.5725, z -0.0925..-0.0275. The spine (z -0.1015..-0.0735) overlaps it over x 0.5175-0.545, z -0.0925..-0.0735, so the rail covers the plaque's first glyph. It reads as a stick dropped on the cap. In c_27313/14 the spine dies into the cap flush, with a fillet, and both plaques are clear.
issues.evidence: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Calc/813f08e2-8818-55ab-8891-7df3b4b5324a/scratchpad/cap1.png and /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Calc/813f08e2-8818-55ab-8891-7df3b4b5324a/scratchpad/cap2.png (cabin build of HEAD, camera over the 17E/18D cap): the rail end lies on the 18D plaque. Also r3 (345,335-352), r5 (crop) and r1 (250-270,145-160) show the stub on the cap.
issues.fix: 09c_room.js lines 437-439: stop the spine at the cap's inner face and blend it in. Grooves: gBox(1.065, ...) at x -0.0525. Spine: gRBox(1.075, 0.05, 0.028, 0.008, 1) at M4.trs(-0.0475, MON.top + 0.025, mz). Rail: gRBox(1.077, 0.008, 0.032, 0.004, 1) at x -0.0465. Then add a low fillet foot where it meets the cap: B.add(gRBox(0.03, 0.05, 0.06, 0.012, 1), M4.trs(0.475, MON.top + 0.025, mz), shell), so the top of the spine (1.14) is flush with the cap top (1.14) and nothing sits on the cap. Check cap2 again: the '18D' plaque should be fully clear.

issues.detail: The spine meets the cap about 20 % along it, not at the centre between the plaques
issues.problem: In c_27313 (crop 300-640 x 300-440) the spine meets the cap exactly at its centre (spine x 464, cap 316-612). The order across it is plaque 17E, spine, oval recess, plaque 18D. Ours (r3, r5, cap1) is 17E, oval recess at the centre, spine about 0.06 m from 18D, then 18D. The cap (z -0.58..0.035) is centred on z -0.2725, but the spine follows the monument at z -0.0875. So either the cap and plaques should be centred on the monument line, or the spine is not on the monument centre in the real seat. Both pair photos agree it is centred on the cap.
issues.evidence: c_27313 / c_27314 crops vs /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Calc/813f08e2-8818-55ab-8891-7df3b4b5324a/scratchpad/cap1.png; r3 cap 310-470 px with the spine at 345.
issues.fix: Do not move the spine off the monument (it must sit between the O and E housings). Instead shift the cap's plaque/recess pattern so the spine falls between the plaques. Shared 09_seats.js line ~269 (one-line edit): room plaque z s.odd ? -0.50 : -0.06 -> s.odd ? -0.30 : 0.005 (E plaque spanning -0.0275..0.0375 clears the spine edge -0.0735 by 4.6 cm, but it overhangs the cap end 0.038). Alternatively extend the cap +z by 0.03 (09c line 422: length ez1 - ez0 + 0.006 -> + 0.036, centre ezc + 0.015). Move the finger recess (line 423) from ezc to mz - 0.10 (about -0.19), between the spine and the O plaque, matching the photo's recess right of the spine. See the questions on whether to recentre the whole aisle tower.

issues.detail: The spine's 'metal rail' renders darker than the housings; the photo spine top is lighter
issues.problem: Line 439 uses SEATMAT.jPanelEdge = '#5d6166' (r 0.34, m 0.5), which is almost the jShell tone '#595d64'. Being metallic it renders darker still. Cap2 samples: spine 105-109, housings 117 (R). In c_27314 the spine top is (177,186,191) and the housing tops are (141-156): a lighter brushed-metal line about 1.2x the housings. So the feature the w9 fix was meant to add, a light metal line splitting two dark housings, does not read. Only the black grooves carry it.
issues.fix: 09c line 439: SEATMAT.jPanelEdge -> { c: '#9aa0a7', r: 0.3, m: 0.6, l: LAYER.brushed } (between jRail #b9bec4 and the shell). Optionally narrow the grooves (line 437 gBox depth 0.014 -> 0.010) so the black lines do not dominate. In the photo they are 1-2 px at about 3 px/cm.

At nu 30 the cells are also about 2.3 cm, so the 2.4 cm-sigma valley is only about 2 vertices wide. In tpg_72 the comforter's main relief is the stitched grid, with one or two soft folds.

questions: c_27313/14 put the spine at the centre of the aisle cap. Our cap and ash tower span the O table plus the monument (z -0.58..0.035), so its centre is 0.185 m forward of the monument. Is the real aisle tower centred on the monument (i.e. our O side table is shorter, or the tower extends over E's door pocket)? A straight-down aisle photo of one pair (e.g. omaat_room_13 or a tpg overhead) would settle whether to move the plaques/recess only, or the whole tower.
